sources.title: OpenStax Biology 2e, 8.3 Using Light Energy to Make Organic Molecules
sources.observation: The Evolution Connection paragraph uses ATP and NADH. The same page's opening and reduction discussion use ATP and NADPH. This confirms a public source-level terminology inconsistency, rather than proving a teacher-only transcription error.

sources.title: OpenStax Biology 2e, 8.2 The Light-Dependent Reactions of Photosynthesis
sources.observation: The detailed mechanism identifies photosystem I reducing NADP+ to NADPH and a proton gradient driving ATP synthesis. The page also contains the public photography credit Jason Hollinger.

sources.title: OpenStax Concepts of Biology, 5.3 The Calvin Cycle
sources.observation: The carrier description and reduction discussion identify ATP and NADPH connecting light reactions and Calvin-cycle carbohydrate synthesis.

scope: Public primary-source cross-check for diagnosis; no new experimental or independent model result
